feedback: Charter ACs should separate semantic deltas from line-diff arithmetic — the '+1 insertion, 0 deletions' phrasing was unsatisfiable as written for an in-line keyword addition and forced a documented deviation.
Charters should not forecast unobserved tool behavior — the 'silent exit 0' biome assumption inverted into a structural exit 1 under biome 2.5.11, and the caveat clause is what saved the AC's intent.

Provenance instructions should name the identifier's kind and its on-disk artifact up front (agent id with its task output path vs parent session id); the ambiguity cost a full fail-closed round trip that a one-line path would have prevented.

Baking the generated-data prebuild chain into worktree bootstrap (or relaxing the pre-commit typecheck for fresh worktrees) would remove a guaranteed failed-commit cycle from every dispatched implementer.
